description: Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative (RGGI) CO2 allowance auctions: auction number and date, quantity offered, Cost Containment Reserve sold, quantity sold, clearing price (USD per allowance) and total proceeds, latest first, from RGGI's public auction results table.
